title: Creamy Cauliflower Soup
description: Creamy Cauliflower Soup is a rich and velvety Continental soup made with tender cauliflower, aromatic vegetables, and finished with fresh cream. Smooth, comforting, and elegant, it is perfect as a starter or a light meal.

ingredients.title: For the Soup
items: Vegetable or chicken stock (preferably homemade) – 1 liter (4 cups)
Heavy cream (or crème fraîche for extra richness) – 200 ml
Freshly ground white pepper – to taste
Fresh chives or parsley, finely chopped – for garnish

instruction.title: Step 1 – Sweat the Aromatics
steps: In a large saucepan, heat butter and olive oil over medium heat.
Sauté gently for 5–7 minutes until soft but not browned.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Cook the Vegetables
steps: Add cauliflower florets and diced potato to the pan.
Stir for 2–3 minutes to coat with the butter and aromatics.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Add Stock and Simmer
steps: Pour in the stock and bring to a gentle boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes until the cauliflower and potato are tender.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Blend to Perfection
steps: Use an immersion blender (or transfer in batches to a countertop blender) to purée the soup until completely smooth.
For an ultra-silky texture, strain through a fine sieve.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Enrich the Soup
steps: Return the soup to low heat.
Stir in the heavy cream and season with salt, white pepper, and a pinch of nutmeg.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Finish Like a Chef
steps: Drizzle with a few drops of truffle oil if desired.

instruction.title: Step 7 – Plating
steps: Garnish with finely chopped chives or parsley.
For a restaurant touch, add a swirl of cream or a small cauliflower floret on top.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with crusty bread, garlic crostini, or buttered rolls.
Garnish with fresh herbs and a swirl of cream.
Finish with a drizzle of truffle oil for an elegant presentation.

chefTips: Roast the cauliflower lightly before cooking for a nuttier, deeper flavor.
For a vegan version, substitute butter with olive oil and cream with coconut or cashew cream.
A squeeze of lemon juice at the end brightens the soup beautifully.
Strain the soup through a fine sieve for an ultra-smooth restaurant-quality texture.
